facts.text: The Tides Inn is a waterfront resort on a tributary of the Chesapeake Bay.
facts.excerpt: The Tides Inn is a waterfront resort situated on a tributary of America’s most important estuary, the Chesapeake Bay.

facts.text: The resort is just under three hours from Washington, DC and one hour from Richmond.
facts.excerpt: Just under three hours from Washington, DC and one hour from Richmond

facts.text: A twenty-seven-slip overnight marina welcomes sail-in guests.
facts.excerpt: A twenty-seven–slip overnight marina also welcomes sail-in guests.

facts.text: The Tides Inn opened to the public on July 15, 1947.
facts.excerpt: On July 15th, 1947, the Tides Inn opened to the public

facts.text: In the early 1940s, the land the Tides Inn sits on was known as the Ashburn Farm.
facts.excerpt: In the early 1940s, the land on which the Tides Inn now sits was known as the Ashburn Farm.

facts.text: Handcrafted wooden liquor lockers from the hotel's dry-county early days still line the walls of Salt & Meadow Restaurant.
facts.excerpt: These handcrafted wooden lockers continue to adorn the walls of our Salt & Meadow Restaurant.

facts.text: A $3.6 million shoreline restoration project added a Shoreline Trail along Carter's Creek, surrounded by an oyster reef and wetland grasses.
facts.excerpt: Our $3.6 million shoreline restoration project features a Shoreline Trail along Carter’s Creek, which is surrounded by the oyster reef and wetland grasses

facts.text: The Tides Inn completed a shoreline restoration project in 2022.
facts.excerpt: The Tides Inn completed a shoreline restoration project in 2022.

facts.text: In the Watermen's Experience, guests haul oyster cages with the resort's resident ecologist.
facts.excerpt: As you haul oyster cages up from the depths below, you'll explore the rhythms of modern oyster aquaculture with our resident ecologist.

facts.text: In the Beautiful Swimmers blue crab experience, guests learn how to set and pull crab pots.
facts.excerpt: You’ll get hands-on as you learn how to set and pull crab pots

facts.text: Coastal Seaplane Experiences offers seaplane tours boarding at the Tides Inn Beach, taking off and landing on Carter's Creek.
facts.excerpt: Climb aboard at the Tides Inn Beach and enjoy a smooth take-off and landing in the calm waters of Carter’s Creek.

facts.text: On the Mighty Rappahannock cruise, Captain Bull shares the history of the Rappahannock River aboard the Lil' Tip-Sea.
facts.excerpt: Cruise aboard the Lil’ Tip-Sea and along the way he will share the history of the Rappahannock River over the last 400 years

facts.text: All Water View rooms have views of the shoreline, beach or marina.
facts.excerpt: Water View guest rooms are aptly named as all feature views of our beautiful shoreline, beach or marina.

facts.text: Connected two- and three-bedroom rooms and suites come in a variety of bed and balcony configurations.
facts.excerpt: These thoughtfully connected two- and three-bedroom rooms and suites feature a variety of bed and balcony configurations

facts.text: The daily resort fee includes the fitness center, beach and pool access, tennis and pickleball.
facts.excerpt: The daily resort fee includes our fitness center, beach and pool access,tennis, pickleball, and more.

facts.text: Salt & Meadow draws heirloom vegetables, herbs and honey daily from the five-acre Tides Inn Farm.
facts.excerpt: heirloom vegetables, herbs, and honey arrive daily from our five-acre Tides Inn Farm

facts.text: Fish Hawk offers indoor or outdoor dining overlooking Carter's Creek, with an old-fashioned ice cream counter.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a casual, upbeat setting with indoor or outdoor dining overlooking Carter’s Creek. Stop by the old-fashioned ice cream counter

facts.text: The Tides of History Speaker Series is complimentary and requires no reservations.
facts.excerpt: These experiences are complimentary and do not require reservations.

facts.text: The beach, steps from the water, can host a reception, dinner or evening bonfire.
facts.excerpt: Steps from the water, the beach is a memorable event space for a reception, dinner or evening bonfire.

facts.text: The Historical Garden Tour is seasonal, offered June 10 through October 15.
facts.excerpt: Offered Wednesdays and Fridays from 9:00–10:00 AM (June 10th through October 15th),

facts.text: As part of America's 250th anniversary, the Tides Inn launched Tides 250, programs exploring the Chesapeake region's story since 1776.
facts.excerpt: As part of America’s 250th anniversary, the Tides Inn has launched Tides 250

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the inn as on a private peninsula.
facts.excerpt: this waterfront inn located on a private peninsula

facts.text: The resort has signature lime-green cruise bikes for exploring the town.
facts.excerpt: The resort’s signature lime-green cruise bikes are an ideal way to explore the town.

facts.text: Room count: official site says sixty-seven rooms and suites; Conde Nast Traveler says 106 rooms.
facts.excerpt: Sixty-seven rooms and suites welcome the outdoors in with views of the water, shorelines and gardens.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists 106 rooms.
facts.excerpt: the 106-room Tides Inn
